Trust decision: `doPriorityConfigSubmit` may rewrite job groups only via POST and, when `onlyAdminsMayEditPriorityConfiguration` is on, only for `Jenkins.ADMINISTER` — at the pinned commit it enforces neither (`PriorityConfiguration.java:169-191` vs the page gate at `:127-140`).
`pattern_fit`: `injection_only` (single source site, no second module, no reachable uncovered route).
Strongest lever: the coupled conditional — `checkActive()` must stay false-tolerant, so an unconditional ADMINISTER check or POST-only fix breaks the documented default and leaves the authz half open.
Biggest red flag: `single_site` (plus `tiny_repo`) — one function in one file, so any difficulty has to come from a planted sibling.
